definitions.explanation: The seventh month of the year. The rainy season ends and summer begins in earnest. Features Tanabata (July 7th).

examples.japanese: {七月|しちがつ}は{暑|あつ}いです。
{七月|しちがつ}は{夏|なつ}です。
{七月|しちがつ}になると{海|うみ}に{行|い}きたくなります。
examples.english: When July comes, I want to go to the beach.

examples.japanese: {七月|しちがつ}の{終|お}わりから{学校|がっこう}が{休|やす}みになります。
examples.english: School is off from the end of July.

examples.japanese: {七月|しちがつ}に{毎年|まいとし}{海|うみ}で{泳|およ}いでいますが、{今年|ことし}も{行|い}きたいと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I swim in the sea every year in July, and I'd like to go this year too.

notes:
{七月|しちがつ} is the seventh month of the year.

PRONUNCIATION:
- Standard: しちがつ
- Alternative: なながつ (to avoid confusion with いちがつ)

JAPANESE MONTHS:
All months use number + {月|がつ}:
- {一月|いちがつ} (January) through {十二月|じゅうにがつ} (December)

JULY EVENTS:
- {七夕|たなばた} (July 7): Star Festival celebrating the yearly meeting of Orihime and Hikoboshi
- {海|うみ}の{日|ひ} (3rd Monday): Marine Day holiday
- {梅雨明|つゆあ}け: End of rainy season
- {夏休|なつやす}み{開始|かいし}: Summer vacation begins

SEASON:
July marks the beginning of true summer ({夏|なつ}) after the rainy season ends.
